Dedupe added at `src/router.js:32`, state now `{ lastSentAt: Map }` keyed by `event.key`.

Rules order: dedupe first, then quiet hours, then priority table. Only non-empty results stamp the key, so a dropped repeat doesn't extend its own window; queued notifications count as sent.

Window boundary: suppressed when `at - lastSentAt < 5` (a repeat exactly 5 minutes later goes through).

Replay: 99 dropped, 0 errors. Flaps at +2 min suppressed (`evt-0018` after `evt-0017`), including critical — no priority exempt, since you didn't carve one out.
